```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

theme_tigit <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e6ebf0", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0, color = "#17202a"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#17202a"),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

indicators <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/municipal-indicators-tarragones-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

fig <- ggplot(indicators, aes(x = "Municipis", y = housing_non_main_pct)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "#c6dbef",
    color = "#2171b5",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    outlier.color = "#b2182b",
    outlier.shape = 21,
    outlier.fill = "#b2182b",
    outlier.size = 2.4,
    width = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.06, seed = 42),
    color = "#2171b5",
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 1.6
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribució del percentatge d'habitatge no principal dels municipis del Tarragonès (2021)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentatge d'habitatge no principal",
    caption = "La caixa abasta els quartils, la línia central la mediana i els punts superposats, cada municipi. n = 22 municipis. Font: Idescat, habitatges per tipus d'habitatge, 2021."
  ) +
  theme_tigit() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/boxplot-housing-non-main-tarragones-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 8, height = 4.5, device = svglite::svglite)
```
